The target CVE-2020-24572 requires 'With authenticated access' to RaspAP 2.5 and then describes post-authentication command execution on the underlying Raspberry Pi OS: an attacker can 'execute commands on the system' on the 'underlying OS (Raspberry Pi)'. The edge's bridge, that administrative host access allows extracting or resetting RaspAP web console authentication credentials, is not stated in CVE-2020-24572 or any supplied source CVE description. That bridge would require additional unverified assumptions about same-host deployment and accessible credential storage or reset paths. Therefore the edge is unsupported and cannot enter a strict evidence graph.
